title.defaultFlexible: Assemble an OPTC team from enemy mechanics and ability filters.
title.defaultStrict: Assemble an exact-match OPTC team from enemy mechanics and ability filters.
title.withTypesFlexible: Build a {{types}} OPTC team with smart fallback when needed.
title.withTypesStrict: Build a {{types}} OPTC team with exact-match rules only.

description.defaultFlexible: Pick classes, lock units, add enemy mechanics and utility requirements, then let the auto team builder relax only what it must.
description.defaultStrict: Pick classes, lock units, add enemy mechanics and utility requirements, and keep every selected rule mandatory.
description.withTypesFlexible: The auto team builder prioritizes {{types}} coverage first, then uses controlled fallback if the local pool is too narrow.
description.withTypesStrict: The auto team builder only accepts results that preserve {{types}} coverage and every strict filter you enabled.

support.strict: Every selected type must appear at least once in the final team.
support.flexible: The builder tries to cover every selected type first and only relaxes that in the result panel if needed.

classes.label: Classes
classes.toggle: Require every slot to match selected classes

support.strict: Every selected unit in the final team must match all selected classes.
support.flexible: Selected classes guide captain scope and candidate weighting without blocking fallback.

support.strict: Every selected character tag must appear somewhere in the final team. One character can cover multiple tags.
support.flexible: Selected character tags are preferences first and can be relaxed in fallback.

support.strict: Every selected name must be covered by a distinct final team slot.
support.flexible: Selected names are preferred and fuzzy-matched, but can be relaxed in fallback.

modal.title: Choose a requirement source
modal.copy: Only characters with extractable Captain, Full Coverage, Super Special, or Super Tandem roster requirements are shown.
modal.support: Apply copies ability-derived required tags and names into the relaxed filters.
modal.empty: No source characters with extractable roster requirements matched this search.

support.strict: Every final slot except Friend Captain must avoid in-game duplicate-character conflicts, so the Friend Captain can still mirror another unit like Monkey D. Luffy.
support.flexible: Allow final teams that reuse in-game character identities or overlapping composite units.

leaderSuperEffectScope.toggle: Require every slot to match leader super effect scope

support.strict: Every final slot must match every selected Super Type / Super Class / Super Special scope, and those activation requirements stay strict.
support.flexible: Default mode tries leaders without Super Type / Super Class effects first, then allows super leaders before relaxing classes or types.

support.simple: Default mode filters teams by the leader's standard HP/ATK boost scope only.
support.full: Every final slot, including Captain and Friend Captain, must satisfy all targetable Captain Ability clauses.

bothLeadersCaptainCoverage.toggle: Require both leaders to pass Captain Ability coverage

support.flexible: Allow teams where only one leader fully passes, and show the warning in the result.
support.strict: Captain and Friend Captain must both fully pass every slot and team-count Captain Ability condition.

support.flexible: The builder tries to activate every team's Super Special Criteria first and warns if it must relax them.
support.strict: Every final unit with Super Special Criteria must be activatable in battle.

support.flexible: The builder tries to activate every team's Super Tandem first and warns if it must relax them.
support.strict: Every final unit with Super Tandem criteria must be activatable in battle.

support.hp: Captain and Friend Captain auto-fill prefers the highest HP captain boost, then newest character, then higher cost.
support.atk: Captain and Friend Captain auto-fill prefers the highest ATK captain boost, then newest character, then higher cost.
support.average: Captain and Friend Captain auto-fill prefers the highest average of HP and ATK captain boosts, then newest character, then higher cost.

range.invalid: Leader boost minimum cannot be greater than maximum.

cost.label: Auto-fill cost ranges
cost.support: Set separate cost ranges for auto-filled leaders and subs. Manual picks remain unrestricted.

support.default: Leave both fields empty to allow any cost for auto-filled Captain and Friend Captain.
support.active: Only auto-filled Captain and Friend Captain inside this cost range can be selected.

range.invalid: Minimum leader cost cannot be greater than maximum leader cost.

support.default: Leave both fields empty to allow any cost for auto-filled subs.
support.active: Only auto-filled subs inside this cost range can be selected.

range.invalid: Minimum sub cost cannot be greater than maximum sub cost.

support.default: Leave empty for no total cost limit. Friend Captain cost is ignored.
support.active: {{used}} / {{max}} cost used. {{remaining}} cost remains for Captain and subs.

range.overBudget: Manual picks use {{used}} cost, above the {{max}} limit.
